# Autonomous Pipeline Monitoring
Track Azure Data Factory execution health and failures.

content.title: Pipeline Runs — Last 7 Days
content.query: ADFPipelineRun | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize TotalRuns=count(), SuccessfulRuns=countif(Status == 'Succeeded'), FailedRuns=countif(Status == 'Failed') | extend SuccessRate=round(100.0 * SuccessfulRuns / TotalRuns, 2)

content.title: Pipeline Failures Over Time
content.query: ADFPipelineRun | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where Status == 'Failed' | summarize Failures=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) | render timechart
